```yaml
name: Ampcode PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    branches: [main, staging]

jobs:
  ampcode-review:
    if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.draft }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    concurrency:
      group: ampcode-pr-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    strategy:
      matrix:
        pr: [${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}]
      max-parallel: 3
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Ampcode CLI
        run: npm install -g @sourcegraph/amp

      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed_files
        run: |
          git fetch origin ${{ github.base_ref }}:refs/remotes/origin/${{ github.base_ref }}
          files=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }})
          echo "$files" | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|java|go|rb|php|c|cpp|cs|rs|kt|swift)$' | head -n 50 > changed_files.txt
          echo "files=$(cat changed_files.txt | tr '\n' ' ')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run Ampcode review
        id: ampcode
        env:
          AMPCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AMPCODE_API_KEY }}
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if [ -s changed_files.txt ]; then
            amp review $(cat changed_files.txt) --output json > ampcode_output.json
          else
            echo "No relevant files to review."
            exit 0
          fi

      - name: Post review comments
        if: ${{ steps.ampcode.outcome == 'success' && -s ampcode_output.json }}
        run: |
          pr_number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          gh auth login --with-token <<< "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
          jq -c '.[]' ampcode_output.json | while read -r comment; do
            file=$(echo "$comment" | jq -r '.file')
            line=$(echo "$comment" | jq -r '.line')
            body=$(echo "$comment" | jq -r '.message')
            gh pr review "$pr_number" --comment --body "$body" --file "$file" --line "$line"
          done
```
